validation_protocol: Pool existing disjoint selection23 and calibration23 for checkpoint selection; neither enters training. Both have prior upstream exposure. Earliest epoch wins ties. Freeze every selection before any test inference.
metric: Per-image exact casefold-alphanumeric lexical micro-F1, no IoU; all care GT and all 233 test images retained; no DeepSolo.

scientific_choices.PAPER_SPECIFIED: Attention-gated ResNet50 U-Net, segmentation and recognition motivation only.
scientific_choices.REPOSITORY_SPECIFIED: Qualified Text+Kernel checkpoint, word targets, PARSeq, BCE+Dice, existing crop and word admission policy, split and data augmentation.
scientific_choices.ASSUMPTION: 60-epoch comparison; same checkpoint and fixed crop policy; pooled held-out selection; half IC13/half Total-Text loss; fixed 0/30/60 test controls; earliest validation tie.
scientific_choices.HARDWARE_DEVIATION: RTX3090 FP32, batch 8, sequential domain backward, U-Net and PARSeq co-resident.
scientific_choices.UNRESOLVED: Upstream validation and test exposure, small pooled validation, exact paper checkpoint and metric, broader corpus overlap, single seed and no guarantee that 60 epochs is optimal.
